title: Terassipalvelut Kuntsin modernin taiteen museossa
description: Terassipalvelut Kuntsin modernin taiteen museossa Yhteishankintayksikkö TeeSe Botnia Oy pyytää Vaasan kaupungin museoiden toimeksiannosta tarjouksia Kuntsin modernin taiteen museon terassipalveluiden tuottamisesta tämän tarjouspyynnön mukaisesti. Kyseessä on käyttöoikeussopimus, jonka tavoitteena on laadukas ja museoympäristöön soveltuva anniskeluterassitoiminta. Kokonaisuuteen kuuluu ulkona sijaitsevan anniskeluterassin lisäksi keittiötila. Museossa olevan keittiön kapasiteetti on rajallinen, eikä tila sellaisenaan mahdollista varsinaista ravintolatoimintaa. Toiminnan lähtökohtana on siten ensisijaisesti anniskeluterassitoiminta, jota voidaan täydentää tilojen ja niiden varustelun mahdollistamalla pienimuotoisella ruoka- ja muulla tarjoilulla. Valittu palveluntuottaja vastaa toimintansa edellyttämien laitteiden ja muun tarvittavan varustuksen hankkimisesta ja tuomisesta keittiötilaan. Valitun palveluntuottajan tulee kehittää palveluita yhteistyössä Tilaajan kanssa. Kuntsin modernin taiteen museossa järjestetään vuosittain kaksi taidenäyttelyä sekä yksityistilaisuuksia. Museokävijöitä on vuosittain noin 10 000 henkeä. Kuntsin modernin taiteen museo antaa voittaneen tarjouksen jättäneelle palveluntuottajalle Museossa sijaitsevan keittiön sekä Museon länsiseinustalla olevan 200-paikkaisen terassin ja läheisen WC:n tilat vuokralle tarjouspyynnön liitteenä 1 olevassa sopimusluonnoksessa ilmoitettujen vuokra- ja muiden ehtojen mukaisesti ja palveluntuottaja sitoutuu tuottamaan sopimuksen mukaiset palvelut sopimuskaudella. Palveluntuottaja tulee toimimaan näin osaltaan historiallisesti arvokkaassa kiinteistössä, jossa on taidemuseotoimintaa ja arvo-omaisuutta. Lisäksi terassi ja museo sijaitsevat RKY-alueella, joten ympäristön kulttuurihistorialliset arvot on otettava huomioon. Tilojen vuokra on 8 % palveluntuottajan liikevaihdosta, touko-elokuussa kuitenkin vähintään tarjoajan tarjoaman (kohdassa hankinnan kohteen kriteerit) minimivuokran verran. Palveluntuottaja sitoutuu tarjoamaansa minimivuokraan touko-, kesä-, heinä-, ja elokuulta € /kk. . Sopimuksen tavoitteellinen alkamisajankohta 1.4.2027. Sopimus on määräaikainen viiden vuoden ajan. Tutustuminen tiloihin: Tarjoajille järjestetään mahdollisuus tutustua terassiin ja muihin tiloihin ja varustukseen to 3.12.2026 tai pe 4.12.2026 klo 14.00–16.00. Kohteeseen tutustuminen ei ole ehdoton vaatimus tarjouksen jättämiselle. Mikäli tarjoajan mielestä terassi ja/tai sen aputilat edellyttävät muutoksia, tulee niistä neuvotella erikseen kaupungin kanssa.,

title: Belgium – Survey services – Raamovereenkomst betreffende het uitvoeren van bouwkundige en elektromechanische studies
description: Deze dienstenopdracht heeft in hoofdzaak tot doel het uitvoeren van beperkte maar ook omvangrijkere studieopdrachten m.b.t. waterbouwkundige constructies, betonconstructies, staalbouw, elektromechanica, enz. De studieopdrachten binnen deze raamovereenkomst zullen onder andere betrekking hebben op: - Waterbouwkundige constructies: sluizen, kaaimuren ongeacht hun aard en omvang, pontons, dukdalven, bodem- en oeverbekledingen, kaaitoebehoren, enz. delen ervan of in hun geheel; - Betonconstructies: bruggen, funderingen, enz. delen ervan of in hun geheel - Staalbouw: vast overspanningen, beweegbare bruggen, loopbruggen, kaaitoebehoren, enz. delen ervan of in hun geheel; - Andere studies: kleine gebouwen, funderingen, kunststoffen constructies, enz. delen ervan of in hun geheel; - Elektromechanische studies: bewegingsmechanismen, aandrijvingen, hydraulische apparaten, lichtstudies, enz.; - Opmaken van sloop- en/of omgevingsvergunningen. Per studieopdracht zal afzonderlijk en vooraf bepaald worden welke prestaties van de dienstverlener verwacht worden. De opdracht is opgedeeld in volgende percelen: Perceel 1 “Civiele technieken” Perceel 2 “Staalbouw en elektromechanische studies” Volgende prestaties (niet limitatief) zullen mogelijks verwacht worden van de dienstverlener (dit geldt voor beide percelen): • Het uitvoeren van opmetingen, waar nodig in 3D, verwerken en interpreteren van de resultaten; • Inventariseren van beschikbare, bestaande informatie zoals grondonderzoek, materiaalonderzoek, enz. en verwerken en interpreteren van de resultaten en voorstellen doen inzake uit te voeren grondonderzoek, materiaalonderzoek, enz.; • Inventariseren van beschikbare rekennota’s, verwerken en interpreteren van de inhoud van deze rekennota’s, beantwoorden van vragen m.b.t. deze rekennota’s n.a.v. nieuwe, gewijzigde belastingen op de bestaande structuren; • Het opmaken van een hypothesenota in nauw overleg met de opdrachtgever; • Het opmaken van verschillende voorontwerp- en ontwerpdossiers (incl. de nodige stabiliteitsstudies) van zeer kleine en/ of grotere infrastructuurwerken; • Het opstellen van leesbare en duidelijke rekennota’s, in het bijzonder van de lokale en globale stabiliteit, lasberekeningen, vermoeiingsberekeningen, sterkteberekeningen van bepaalde onderdelen en details, enz.; • Opmaken van een ontwerp en aanpassen aan de opmerkingen van de opdrachtgever; • Het uitvoeren van haalbaarheidsstudies; • Het opstellen van sloop- en/of omgevingsvergunningen; • Het bijwonen van vergaderingen en het opstellen van bijhorende verslagen; • Het opstellen van bijhorende ramingen; • Het opstellen van aanbestedingstekeningen - conform de geplogenheden van POAB - en waarvan het detailniveau per studieopdracht voorafgaand af te spreken is met de opdrachtgever. De aanbestedingstekeningen zijn in hoofdzaak overzichtstekeningen, detailtekeningen, werkhuistekeningen, samenstellingstekeningen, bekistings- en wapeningstekeningen met bijhorende buigstaten, enz. op uitvoeringsniveau; • Het verlenen van bijstand aan POAB tijdens de uitvoering van welbepaalde infrastructuurwerken; • Opmaken van een as built dossier;

title: Contrat-cadre - Travaux de menuiserie - Confection, agencement, réparation et entretien
description:
Le présent marché a pour objet la conclusion d’un contrat-cadre régissant les modalités de réalisation de travaux de menuiserie, comprenant notamment la confection, l’agencement, la pose, la réparation, l’entretien et l’adaptation d’ouvrages et d’équipements en bois ou matériaux dérivés dans les locaux d’exploitation, les foyers, les abris de protection civile (PC) ainsi que les appartements gérés par l’Hospice Général.

 

Ce contrat-cadre vise à couvrir des prestations récurrentes et ponctuelles liées aux besoins d’entretien courant, de remise en état, d’aménagement intérieur et d’adaptation des espaces, sur plusieurs années, et non l’acquisition ponctuelle de fournitures ou la réalisation d’un projet unique.


Les prestations pourront notamment inclure la fabrication sur mesure, l’installation et le remplacement de portes, armoires, étagères, plans de travail, éléments de mobilier fixe, cloisons légères, habillages, revêtements bois, ainsi que tous travaux de réparation, de maintenance et d’ajustement nécessaires au maintien en bon état du patrimoine immobilier de l’Hospice Général.

 

L’Hospice Général prévoit d’attribuer jusqu’à trois (3) contrats-cadres à des entreprises adjudicataires distinctes, afin d’assurer la réalisation régulière des travaux de menuiserie en fonction des besoins qui se présenteront au fil du temps.

 

Le contrat-cadre sera conclu pour une durée initiale de quatre (4) ans, avec possibilité de prolongation d’une (1) année supplémentaire d’entente entre les parties, en fonction des besoins de l’Hospice Général et de la performance des prestataires, soit une durée totale maximale de cinq (5) ans.

description: Dem LZN obliegt die Beschaffung von Waren und Dienstleistungen für die unmittelbare niedersächsische Landesverwaltung (vgl. § 2 der Betriebsanweisung des LZN). Mit Zustimmung seiner Aufsichtsbehörde kann das LZN weitere Aufgaben für öffentlich-rechtliche Bedarfsträger innerhalb und außerhalb der niedersächsischen Landesverwaltung sowie für privatrechtliche Gesellschaften in vollständiger Eigentümerschaft der öffentlichen Hand übernehmen (vgl. § 3 Betriebsanweisung). In dieser Zuständigkeit umfasst der Auftrag den Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung mit einem Unternehmen (§ 21 VgV) über die Lieferung von Wollunterwäsche für die Kooperationspartner der norddeutschen Küstenländer der Polizei und Justiz, der Landesforsten und Ordnungsämtern innerhalb von Deutschland und sonstige Behörden (gemäß Anlage) mit einer Preisbindung von 24 Monaten sowie optional zwei einseitige Vertragsverlängerungen zu jeweils höchstens 12 Monaten mit einem Unternehmen. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind der Leistungsbeschreibung -Technischer Teil (Teil B) inkl. Angebotsvordruck zu entnehmen. Nähere Einzelheiten zu Art und Umfang des Auftrags sind den technischen Lieferbedingungen und dem Angebotsvordruck zu entnehmen.

title: APN - Canadian Patrol Submarine Project, CFB Halifax, NS
description: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE CANADIAN PATROL SUBMARINE PROJECT Halifax, NS (with Security Requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at Halifax, NS. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested [contractors and consultants] to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. Contract Number: HX26CPSP; Title: Canadian Patrol Submarine Project - Infrastructure Approximate Estimate:  $5B-$10B Anticipated Posting: January 2027 Description: Following the Prime Minister’s announcement on 6 July 2026, Thyssenkrupp Marine Systems (TKMS) was selected as the preferred supplier to begin negotiations for delivering Canada’s next fleet of submarines. DND needs to be ready with the appropriate enabling infrastructure synchronized with submarine delivery, with boats arriving 2035 or earlier. To support the delivery of the new submarines, DND must deliver complex, multi-site infrastructure at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Halifax at Wright’s Cove by 2033 to enable submarine berthing and maintenance beginning in 2034. The Construction Management (CM) contract will see the construction of jetties, maintenance facilities, training facilities, offices, and a variety of other supporting facilities to support submarine operations and sustainment. This effort will be realized via the execution of a series of successive work packages in Halifax, NS. 3. CONTRACT AWARD AND ANTICIPATED SECURITY REQUIREMENTS This opportunity is restricted to Canadian, German, and Norwegian firms that meet the security clearance requirements. To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is FACILITY SECURITY CLEARANCE (FSC) at up to level II (SECRET)  4. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. 5. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the contractors  to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal.   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note – Contractors that do not submit proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or tenderer regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. 6. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Veronica Mendoza Team Leader, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 902-943-1204 Veronica.Mendoza@dcc-cdc.gc.ca 7. Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations  or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

Le présent appel d'offres porte sur la rénovation des installations de chauffage et de climatisation, y compris la production de chaleur (raccordement au réseau de chauffage urbain), le tracé des conduites, les dispositifs de régulation et de sécurité, la robinetterie ainsi que les travaux annexes nécessaires. La prestation relative aux appareils de chauffage et de climatisation comprend en outre des habillages en bois spécifiés dans le projet. Compte tenu du niveau de protection du bien, tous les travaux doivent être réalisés avec le plus grand soin et en prenant les mesures de protection appropriées pour les éléments de construction adjacents.

title: APN - Canadian Patrol Submarine Project, Esquimalt, B.C.
description: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE Canadian Patrol Submarine Project Esquimalt, BC (With Security Requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at Esquimalt, BC The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. Contract Number: PC26CPSP; Title: Canadian Patrol Submarine Project - Infrastructure Approximate Estimate:  $5B-$10B Anticipated Posting: January 2027 Description: Following the Prime Minister’s announcement on 6 July 2026, Thyssenkrupp Marine Systems (TKMS) was selected as the preferred supplier to begin negotiations for delivering Canada’s next fleet of submarines. DND needs to be ready with the appropriate enabling infrastructure synchronized with submarine delivery, with boats arriving 2035 or earlier. To support to the delivery of the new submarines, DND must deliver complex infrastructure at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Esquimalt in Colwood by 2035 to enable submarine berthing and maintenance beginning in 2036. The Construction Management (CM) contract will see the construction of jetties, maintenance facilities, training facilities, offices, and a variety of other supporting facilities to support submarine operations and sustainment. This effort will be realized via the execution of a series of successive work packages in Victoria, BC. 3. CONTRACT AWARD AND ANTICIPATED SECURITY REQUIREMENTS This opportunity is restricted to Canadian, German, and Norwegian firms that meet the security clearance requirements. To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is FACILITY SECURITY CLEARANCE (FSC) at up to level II (SECRET) 4. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential  proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. 5. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal.   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note – Contractors that do not submit proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or tenderer regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the tenderer or proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. 6. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Danielle Flynn Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada (778) 789-3070 Danielle.Flynn@dcc-cdc.gc.ca 7. Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations  or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: Totalberedskap på tvers av landegrenser
description: Totalberedskap på tvers av landegrenser - Kommuner og fylkeskommuner i grenseoverskridende samhandling for styrket beredskap og motstandskraft. KS ønsker å utrede hvilket potensial som ligger i å utvikle totalberedskap gjennom samarbeid på tvers av landegrensene, og ønsker tilbud på et FoU-prosjekt som skal svare ut følgende problemstillinger: - Hvordan kan kommuner/fylkeskommuner på norsk og svensk side utvikle et felles rammeverk for beredskap og krisehåndtering som sikrer effektiv samhandling ved grenseoverskridende hendelser? - Hvilke potensielle gevinster vil et slikt utvidet samarbeid over grensen på beredskapsområdet gi for kommuner, fylkeskommuner, innbyggerne og andre beredskapsak. Prosjektet skal ha både strategisk og operativt perspektiv på beredskapsarbeidet underveis. Herunder spesielt se på hvordan kommunenes operative redningsressurs brann og redning kan bidra til å styrke kommunenes samlede beredskapsevne på tvers av landegrensene, spesielt i situasjoner høyt i krisespekteret.

title: Netherlands – Building-cleaning services – Schoonmaakonderhoud, glasbewassing en sanitaire voorzieningen
description: De opdracht betreft het integraal verzorgen van schoonmaakonderhoud, glasbewassing en sanitaire voorzieningen voor de gemeente Leidschendam-Voorburg. De dienstverlening omvat resultaatgericht schoonmaakonderhoud, periodiek vloeronderhoud, tapijtreiniging, glasbewassing, additionele en regiewerkzaamheden, ondersteuning bij duurzame koffie- en theebekers en het reinigen van ICT-middelen. De scope omvat 16 gemeentelijke locaties, waaronder kantoren, scholen, gymzalen en maatschappelijke voorzieningen, met een totale oppervlakte van circa 20.760 m². Vanaf 1 juni 2029 worden tevens het voorraadbeheer, de levering van sanitaire dispensers en sanitaire verbruiksartikelen onderdeel van de overeenkomst. De overeenkomst start op 1 juni 2027 met een initiële looptijd van twee jaar en een maximale verlengingsmogelijkheid van zes jaar. Het jaarlijkse inschrijvingsbedrag valt binnen een bandbreedte van € 840.000 tot € 945.000 exclusief btw.

D--USGS L10 MOC & Operations Updates
description: Following the May 2026 RFI feedback and one-on-one meetings with industry, the USGS has matured its acquisition strategy for the Landsat 10 Mission Operations Center and Flight Operations scope of work. USGS intends to procure a new commercial, cloud-based or containerized cloud-native MOC to be hosted using USGS's Cloud Hosting Services (CHS) III services or EROS mission infrastructure Container (Kubernetes) Hosting Solution, respectively. Based on industry feedback and technical study results, the Government is no longer considering the option to augment the existing Landsat 8 and 9 LMOC. Included in this announcement are the following reference materials: 1) Draft MOC/Ops Synopsis Document 2) Draft MOC Requirements Document The Government is not requesting feedback at this time; industry will have an opportunity to provide feedback when the Draft RFP is released. These draft documents build on feedback received in response to the May 2026 RFI and provide industry with additional technical detail to clarify the Government's current approach to the Landsat 10 MOC Development and Operations scope of work. These documents will continue to be refined following the spacecraft award and feedback on the draft RFP leading up to the final RFP release. The MOC functions document previously shared with the RFI has been incorporated into the MOC Synopsis and will no longer be issued as a standalone RFP document. USGS is working toward the following timeline for the RFP surrounding this scope of work: * Draft RFP Release: Estimating early February 2027 (anticipate this will be following spacecraft RFP award) * Industry briefing (virtual): Shortly after Draft RFP announcement * Feedback response period: Anticipated to be 30 days * Tentative one-on-one meetings with contractors as needed to clarify any feedback provided (could be virtual or in-person, at the government's discretion) * Final RFP Release: As soon as possible following updates to documentation based on industry feedback. Estimating May 2027

Da die APEE sowohl von geübten als auch von weniger geübten Anwenderinnen und Anwendern bedient wird, sind eine hohe Bedienungseffizienz, eine hohe Betriebsstabilität sowie eine hohe Benutzerfreundlichkeit von Hard- und Software von zentraler Bedeutung. Zudem muss das System mit seinen Abmessungen in den hierfür zur Verfügung stehenden Laborraum passen. Die verfügbaren Raummasse sind den Eignungskriterien zu entnehmen.

Le Centre comporte au minimum, selon des exigences exprimées en fonctions et en performances, un stand de tir d’au moins 25 mètres, un stand d’au moins 50 mètres et un stand d’au moins 100 mètres, un espace de simulation de tir d’au moins 400 m², une zone tactique intérieure d’au moins 350 m², une zone tactique extérieure d’au moins 4.500 m², une zone d’entraînement des unités canines d’au moins 200 m², un dojo, des locaux sécurisés de dépôt d’armes et de munitions, des salles de formation et de réunion, des vestiaires, une zone de tir accessible au public par un accès distinct, ainsi qu’un parking public et un parking sécurisé réservé à la police. Le soumissionnaire conserve la liberté de la conception architecturale et du choix des solutions techniques. Une attention particulière est portée à la ventilation et à la filtration des stands de tir, à l’acoustique, à l’intégration paysagère et à la neutralité visuelle du site. Le concessionnaire assume l’intégralité des risques de conception, de financement, de construction, de disponibilité et de demande. Il ne bénéficie d’aucune subvention, d’aucune garantie d’emprunt ni d’aucune garantie de rentabilité. Sa rémunération consiste dans le droit d’exploiter le Centre et d’en percevoir les recettes. Il garantit aux Membres l’occupation exclusive de l’ensemble des installations au moins 1 jour complet par semaine, en journée, du lundi au vendredi, à un tarif journalier forfaitaire qui ne peut excéder 1.700 euros hors taxe sur la valeur ajoutée et qui est indexé annuellement. Il leur propose en outre la fourniture des munitions, des cibles et des matériels spécifiques à un prix encadré. En dehors de ces plages, il exploite librement le Centre au profit de tiers, à savoir d’autres zones de police, des administrations publiques, des entreprises de sécurité privée agréées et des cercles de tir autorisés, dans le respect d’obligations strictes de cloisonnement, de sécurité et de confidentialité. Le dossier de demande de permis est déposé dans les 9 mois de la notification de l’approbation de l’offre. Les travaux débutent dans les 6 mois du jour où le permis est devenu définitif et exécutoire et sont achevés dans les 24 mois de leur commencement. La procédure se déroule en une seule phase : tout opérateur économique intéressé peut déposer une offre, et des négociations peuvent être menées avec les soumissionnaires ayant remis une offre régulière. La concession est attribuée à l’offre économiquement la plus avantageuse sur la base de 5 critères : conception opérationnelle (40 points), conception architecturale, qualité environnementale et intégration paysagère (20 points), conditions financières offertes aux Membres (20 points), capacités techniques de maîtrise d’ouvrage, de gestion, de maintenance et d’exploitation (10 points), crédibilité du plan d’affaires et du taux de remplissage hors plages policières (10 points). Une séance d’information et une visite du site, obligatoires, sont organisées le 30 novembre 2026 ; l’attestation de visite doit être jointe à l’offre à peine de nullité. Les modalités de cette visite, en ce compris la possibilité de solliciter une visite complémentaire, ainsi que les conditions de participation, les exigences minimales et l’ensemble des clauses de la concession figurent dans le cahier spécial des charges et ses annexes, auxquels il est renvoyé.

title: Slovakia – Railway signalling works – ŽSR, ETCS L2 v úseku ŽST Vrútky nákl. st. (mimo) - ŽST Ľubochňa (mimo)
description: Predmetom zákazky s názvom „ŽSR, ETCS L2 v úseku ŽST Vrútky nákl. st. (mimo) - ŽST Ľubochňa (mimo)“ je: - vypracovanie a dodanie projektovej dokumentácie v stupni stavebný zámer a projekt stavby v podrobnostiach vykonávacieho projektu vrátane geodetického zamerania, - zabezpečenie súvisiacej inžinierskej činnosti, výsledkom ktorej bude zabezpečenie právoplatného rozhodnutia o stavebnom zámere a overenia projektu stavby (vrátane zabezpečenia predĺženia ich platnosti v prípade potreby; a v prípade, že rozhodnutie o stavebnom zámere stratí platnosť, zabezpečenie vydania nového právoplatného rozhodnutia o stavebnom zámere a overenia projektu stavby), - zabezpečenie majetkovo-právneho vysporiadania vlastníkov pozemkov formou trvalého záberu alebo zriadením vecného bremena, a to ku konaniu o stavebnom zámere, alebo v prípade novozisteného vlastníka resp. vlastníkov ku dňu podania návrhu na kolaudáciu stavby, ak bude potrebné, - uskutočnenie stavebných prác, - zabezpečenie súvisiacej inžinierskej činnosti počas uskutočňovania stavebných prác, výsledkom ktorej bude zabezpečenie právoplatného kolaudačného osvedčenia resp. právoplatných kolaudačných osvedčení, - vypracovanie a dodanie projektovej dokumentácie skutočného zhotovenia stavby, (ďalej aj ako „predmet zákazky“ v príslušnom gramatickom tvare). Zákazka je zadávaná na základe úlohy z Uznesenia vlády Slovenskej republiky č. 604/2025 z 3. decembra 2025 k návrhu Akčného plánu zvýšenia bezpečnosti železničnej dopravy na Slovensku. Cieľom je realizácia a zavedenie systému ETCS L2 BL3 alebo vyššej verzie v úseku ŽST Varín - Výh. Paludza po častiach ŽST Varín (mimo) - ŽST Vrútky nákl. st., ŽST Vrútky nákl. st. (mimo) - ŽST Ľubochňa (mimo), ŽST Ľubochňa - ŽST Liptovská Teplá (mimo), ŽST Liptovská Teplá - Výh. Paludza, vrátane integrácie do existujúcich staničných a traťových zabezpečovacích zariadení, telekomunikačnej infraštruktúry a riadiacich dopravných systémov pre personál riadiaci dopravu. Táto zákazka sa týka časti ŽST Vrútky nákl. st. (mimo) - ŽST Ľubochňa (mimo). V súčasnosti je na úseku trate ŽST Vrútky n. s. - ŽST Ľubochňa (mimo) v ŽST Turany a Kraľovany zabezpečovacie zariadenie elektromechanické so svetelnými návestidlami a elektromotorickými prestavníkmi na ovládanie výhybiek, s reléovou časťou obsluhované miestnymi výpravcami, na trati je centralizovaný (Turany - Vrútky) a decentralizovaný jednosmerný (Ľubochňa - Kraľovany, Kraľovany - Turany) reléový automatický blok. Obstarávateľ v rámci uskutočnenia predmetu zákazky požaduje, aby systém ETCS L2 BL3 alebo vyššej verzie bol do existujúcej železničnej infraštruktúry navrhnutý tak, aby si vyžadoval len nevyhnutné zásahy do existujúcej železničnej siete a jej technologických zariadení. Hlavným princípom je maximálne využitie súčasnej infraštruktúry a existujúcich zabezpečovacích zariadení, pričom nové technologické prvky systému ETCS L2 BL3 alebo vyššej verzie budú integrované spôsobom, ktorý minimalizuje stavebné úpravy a prevádzkové obmedzenia. Navrhované riešenie má zabezpečiť implementáciu systému ETCS L2 BL3 alebo vyššej verzie so spätnou kompatibilitou ETCS nižších verzií BL2 a BL3 v súlade s požiadavkami interoperability podľa aktuálne platných TSI CCS, pričom rozsah stavebných a technologických úprav bude obmedzený na tie, ktoré sú nevyhnutné pre funkčnosť systému ETCS, najmä inštaláciu traťových prvkov, zriadenie riadiacich komponentov a zabezpečenie dátovej komunikácie. Navrhovaná technológia ETCS L2 BL3 alebo vyššej verzie musí plne rešpektovať a zohľadňovať súčasné staničné zabezpečovacie zariadenia, traťové zabezpečovacie zariadenia, priecestné zabezpečovacie zariadenia. Pri návrhu a realizácii predmetu zákazky sa musí klásť dôraz na zachovanie kontinuity železničnej prevádzky, minimalizáciu zásahov do existujúcej infraštruktúry a optimalizáciu investičných nákladov pri súčasnom dosiahnutí požadovanej úrovne bezpečnosti, spoľahlivosti a interoperability železničnej siete. Podrobný opis predmetu zákazky je uvedený v súťažných podkladoch (ďalej aj ako "SP").

Obstarávateľ v rámci uskutočnenia predmetu zákazky požaduje, aby systém ETCS L2 BL3 alebo vyššej verzie bol do existujúcej železničnej infraštruktúry navrhnutý tak, aby si vyžadoval len nevyhnutné zásahy do existujúcej železničnej siete a jej technologických zariadení. Hlavným princípom je maximálne využitie súčasnej infraštruktúry a existujúcich zabezpečovacích zariadení, pričom nové technologické prvky systému ETCS L2 BL3 alebo vyššej verzie budú integrované spôsobom, ktorý minimalizuje stavebné úpravy a prevádzkové obmedzenia. Navrhované riešenie má zabezpečiť implementáciu systému ETCS L2 BL3 alebo vyššej verzie so spätnou kompatibilitou ETCS nižších verzií BL2 a BL3 v súlade s požiadavkami interoperability podľa aktuálne platných TSI CCS, pričom rozsah stavebných a technologických úprav bude obmedzený na tie, ktoré sú nevyhnutné pre funkčnosť systému ETCS, najmä inštaláciu traťových prvkov, zriadenie riadiacich komponentov a zabezpečenie dátovej komunikácie. Navrhovaná technológia ETCS L2 BL3 alebo vyššej verzie musí plne rešpektovať a zohľadňovať súčasné staničné zabezpečovacie zariadenia, traťové zabezpečovacie zariadenia, priecestné zabezpečovacie zariadenia. Pri návrhu a realizácii predmetu zákazky sa musí klásť dôraz na zachovanie kontinuity železničnej prevádzky, minimalizáciu zásahov do existujúcej infraštruktúry a optimalizáciu investičných nákladov pri súčasnom dosiahnutí požadovanej úrovne bezpečnosti, spoľahlivosti a interoperability železničnej siete. Podrobný opis predmetu zákazky je uvedený v súťažných podkladoch (ďalej aj ako "SP").

title: Remotely Operated Ground (UGV) and Aerial (UAV) Platforms with Ionizing Radiation Measurement Equipment
description: Procurement description As part of the Finnish RescEU project, the National Emergency Supply Agency (hereinafter "NESA") is preparing in cooperation with Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority (hereinafter "STUK") the procurement of remotely operated ground and aerial platforms equipped with ionizing radiation measurement devices. The equipment will be part of Finnish rescEU stockpile that is part of EU Civil Protection mechanism (UCPM). Countries that are part of the mechanism (“UCPM countries”) include all EU countries and participating countries that are Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Iceland, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Norway, Serbia, Türkiye, Moldova and Ukraine. After emergency these countries can ask for assistance from the mechanism. In case of emergency, the stockpile would be activated and the devices would be sent to emergency area. The most probable end users would be first responders, security sector authorities (police, CBRN teams, defence forces) or rescue service personnel. According to preliminary estimates following quantities will be procured during 2026: - 20 - 30 unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and RN sensor(s) (LOT A) - 4 - 8 tracked and/or wheeled UGVs and RN sensor(s) (LOT B) - 4 - 8 Quadruped UGVs and RN sensors (LOT C) Planned procurement schedule: 1. Request for proposal – November 2026 2. Deadline for tender questions – December 2026 3. Answers to tender questions – December 2026 4. Deadline for tenders – January 2027 5. Evaluation of tenders – January - February 2027 6. Procurement decision and notification to tenderers – March 2027 7. Procurement Agreement signing – March - April 2027, Tracked and/or wheeled UGVs and RN sensor(s) (LOT B) UGV (Unmanned Ground Vehicle) is a ground-based vehicle that operates without an onboard human operator and is controlled either remotely or autonomously by onboard systems. In the context of this procurement Lot, a UGV includes the ground platform, propulsion and mobility systems (tracks and/or wheels), navigation and control systems, communication links, power systems and any sensors, manipulators or payloads required for RN operations. The UGV system may comprise one or more UGV platforms, operator control units, communication links, support equipment, software, interfaces and accessories required for safe and effective operation. The UGV shall be suitable for professional operational use in RN monitoring, survey, inspection and reconnaissance tasks in varied and potentially hazardous environments. RN sensors (Radiological and Nuclear sensors) are devices designed for the detection, measurement, monitoring and/or radionuclide identification of ionizing radiation and radiological and nuclear materials. In the context of this procurement, an RN sensor includes the sensor unit, associated electronics, power interfaces, data acquisition and processing components, and any required firmware/software necessary for its intended operational use. The RN sensors shall be suitable for professional operational use and capable of supporting RN monitoring, survey, detection, identification or reconnaissance tasks under varying environmental and operational conditions. The tenderer shall deliver fully integrated and operational UGV and RN sensor combinations, demonstrated as functional systems prior to acceptance. The tenderer shall be fully responsible for ensuring the mechanical, electrical and functional integration of all platform and RN sensor components offered under the same Lot, regardless of whether these components are supplied by the tenderer or by subcontractors or consortium partners., Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and RN sensor(s) (LOT A) UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) is an aircraft that operates without a pilot on board and is controlled either remotely by a human operator or autonomously by onboard systems. In the context of this procurement, a UAV includes the aerial platform itself, its propulsion system, navigation and flight control systems, communication links, and any onboard sensors and payloads necessary for the intended operational use. The UAV shall be suitable for professional operational use and capable of performing missions related to radiological and nuclear (RN) monitoring, survey or reconnaissance tasks in varying environmental and operational conditions. The UAV may operate under visual line-of-sight (VLOS) or beyond visual line-of-sight (BVLOS) conditions subject to applicable European aviation regulations. RN sensors (Radiological and Nuclear sensors) are devices designed for the detection, measurement, monitoring and/or radionuclide identification of ionizing radiation and radiological and nuclear materials. In the context of this procurement, an RN sensor includes the sensor unit, associated electronics, power interfaces, data acquisition and processing components, and any required firmware/software necessary for its intended operational use. The RN sensors shall be suitable for professional operational use and capable of supporting RN monitoring, survey, detection, identification or reconnaissance tasks under varying environmental and operational conditions. The tenderer shall deliver fully integrated and operational UAV and RN sensor combinations, demonstrated as functional systems prior to acceptance. The tenderer shall be fully responsible for ensuring the mechanical, electrical and functional integration of all platform and RN sensor components offered under the same Lot, regardless of whether these components are supplied by the tenderer or by subcontractors or consortium partners., Quadruped UGVs and RN sensors (LOT C) UGV (Unmanned Ground Vehicle) is a ground-based vehicle that operates without an onboard human operator and is controlled either remotely or autonomously by onboard systems. In the context of this procurement Lot, a UGV includes the ground platform, propulsion and mobility systems (four (4) legs), navigation and control systems, communication links, power systems and any sensors, manipulators or payloads required for RN operations. The UGV system may comprise one or more UGV platforms, operator control units, communication links, support equipment, software, interfaces and accessories required for safe and effective operation. The UGV shall be suitable for professional operational use in RN monitoring, survey, inspection and reconnaissance tasks in varied and potentially hazardous environments. RN sensors (Radiological and Nuclear sensors) are devices designed for the detection, measurement, monitoring and/or radionuclide identification of ionizing radiation and radiological and nuclear materials. In the context of this procurement, an RN sensor includes the sensor unit, associated electronics, power interfaces, data acquisition and processing components, and any required firmware/software necessary for its intended operational use. The RN sensors shall be suitable for professional operational use and capable of supporting RN monitoring, survey, detection, identification or reconnaissance tasks under varying environmental and operational conditions. The tenderer shall deliver fully integrated and operational UGV and RN sensor combinations, demonstrated as functional systems prior to acceptance. The tenderer shall be fully responsible for ensuring the mechanical, electrical and functional integration of all platform and RN sensor components offered under the same Lot, regardless of whether these components are supplied by the tenderer or by subcontractors or consortium partners.,

title: D0440 EFU-10978 Sandbrekkevegen bosenter og utleieboliger, totalentreprenør
description: Sandbrekkeveien bosenter skal være en institusjon med 15 beboerrom fordelt på to avdelinger. En langtidsavdeling med 9 rom og en korttidsavdeling med 6 rom, hver av avdelingene skal ha tilhørende uteområder. Beboergruppen vil være personer som har vedtak om heldøgnsomsorg i aldersgrupper 18-30år. Beboergruppen har alvorlig funksjonsfall grunnet psykiske utfordringer diagnostisert med utviklingsforstyrrelser, eller autismespekterforstyrrelse med lavt funksjonsnivå. Bygget skal i tillegg inneholde nødvendige personalfasiliteter knyttet til avdeling og i personalbase. Uteområdet skal gi en skjermet uteplass for beboere. Tomten har en nylig vedtatt reguleringsplan fra 2024. Denne er utviklet for et bosenter med 9 leiligheter med tilhørende personalarealer, samt 8 ordinære utleie boliger. Dette konseptet er vedtatt endret til det som ligger til grunn i dette prosjektet. Det må påregnes at en i samspillsfasen må vurdere, samt søke dispensasjon fra deler av dette dersom dette viser seg nødvendig. For denne totalentreprisen har byggherren fastsatt et kostnadstak på kr 83,053 mill. ekskl. Mva. Både kontraktens fase 1 og 2 skal gjennomføres innenfor dette kostnadstaket.

title: Gaswerkareal, Gesamtsanierung Werkstattgebäude, Planerwahlverfahren für Architektur, Bauphysik und Gebäudetechnik
description:
Dans le quartier bernois de Marzili, au sud du pont du Monbijou, se trouve le site de l'usine à gaz. Le Fonds pour la politique foncière et de logement de la ville de Berne, représenté par Immobilien Stadt Bern, a repris le site de l’usine à gaz à Energie Wasser Bern (ewb) au 1er janvier 2021. Suite au succès du référendum sur le changement d’affectation et le reclassement en zone à densité élevée (ZPP) à l’automne 2025, le site sera aménagé dans les années à venir.


Le bâtiment des ateliers (Sandrainstrasse 17J) est situé à l’écart de la rue, à mi-hauteur du périmètre d’aménagement du site de l’usine à gaz, entre le centre culturel pour la jeunesse Gaskessel et l’Aar. Il fait partie du projet d’aménagement du site, mais se trouve en dehors de la zone soumise à une obligation de planification (ZPP). Ce bâtiment, inscrit à l’inventaire des monuments dignes de protection, doit être préservé grâce à une rénovation complète et, en tant qu’élément identitaire, passer de son utilisation provisoire actuelle à une nouvelle mixité fonctionnelle axée sur le public. Il doit être ouvert au public et donner une impulsion ciblée au développement futur du site de l’usine à gaz. En raison du retard accumulé en matière d’entretien, le bâtiment doit faire l’objet d’une rénovation en profondeur avant de pouvoir être réaffecté et reloué.


Au sein du bâtiment, plusieurs locataires aux activités variées devraient générer un fort pouvoir d'attraction au-delà du site.


Pour la conception et la réalisation de la rénovation complète, une équipe de conception spécialisée dans les domaines de l'architecture / direction générale des travaux, de la physique du bâtiment et des installations techniques du bâtiment (CVC) est recherchée dans le cadre d'une procédure sélective. Les domaines spécialisés des installations techniques du bâtiment peuvent être pris en charge par une seule ou plusieurs entreprises.

title: Switzerland – Architectural and related services – Gaswerkareal, Gesamtsanierung Werkstattgebäude, Planerwahlverfahren für Architektur, Bauphysik und Gebäudetechnik
description: Im Berner Quartier Marzili liegt südlich der Monbijoubrücke das Gaswerkareal. Der Fonds für Boden- und Wohnbaupolitik der Stadt Bern, vertreten durch Immobilien Stadt Bern, hat das Gaswerkareal per 1. Januar 2021 von Energie Wasser Bern (ewb) übernommen. Nach der erfolgreichen Volksabstimmung über die Um- und Aufzonung (ZPP) im Herbst 2025 wird das Areal in den kommenden Jahren entwickelt. Das Werkstattgebäude (Sandrainstrasse 17J) liegt abseits der Strasse auf mittlerer Höhe des Entwicklungsperimeters Gaswerkareal, zwischen dem Jugendkulturzentrum Gaskessel und der Aare. Es ist Teil der Arealentwicklung, liegt jedoch ausserhalb der Zone mit Planungspflicht (ZPP). Das als schützenswert inventarisierte Gebäude soll mittels einer Gesamtsanierung erhalten und als identitätsstiftendes Element aus der aktuellen Zwischennutzung in einen neuen, publikumsorientierten Nutzungsmix überführt werden. Es soll der Öffentlichkeit zugänglich gemacht werden und einen gezielten Impuls zur weiteren Entwicklung des Gaswerkareals setzen. Aufgrund des aufgestauten Unterhalts muss das Gebäude umfangreich saniert werden, bevor es umgenutzt und neu vermietet werden kann. Im Gebäude sollen mehrere Mietparteien mit diversen Nutzungen eine hohe Anziehungskraft über das Areal hinaus erzeugen. Für die Projektierung und Realisierung der Gesamtsanierung wird in einem selektiven Verfahren ein Planungsteam aus den Fachbereichen Architektur / Gesamtleitung, Bauphysik und Gebäudetechnik (HLK) gesucht. Die Fachbereiche der Gebäudetechnik können durch ein einzelnes oder mehrere Unternehmen abgedeckt werden.

title: MACH1 AOI FA8903-27-OT-001 Horizontal Airfield Infrastructure
description: The scope of this AOI encompasses planning, design, engineering, alteration, repair, and physical construction for airfield pavement assets and associated systems. Incidental civil, electrical, mechanical, utility, environmental, and site work directly supporting the primary airfield infrastructure is authorized and included within this scope. All facility types, infrastructure systems, technical specialties, and testing capabilities identified throughout this document are expressly illustrative and non-exhaustive, including but not limited to: Horizontal airfield pavements and operating surfaces, including but not limited to runways, taxiways, aircraft parking aprons, arm/de-arm pads, compass swing bases, holding pads, alert pads, aircraft wash-rack pavements, access roadways, perimeter security paths, and all associated horizontal airfield pavements. Airfield visual and electrical systems, including but not limited to runway edge and centerline lighting, threshold and end lighting, taxiway guidance lighting, approach lighting systems, precision approach path indicators (PAPIs), airfield signage, electrical duct banks, vault infrastructure, counterpoise grounding grids, automated Airfield Lighting Control and Monitoring Systems (ALCMS), mobile aircraft arresting systems (MAAS), and related navigational and visual aids. Civil, drainage, and safety infrastructure, including but not limited to subsurface stormwater drainage networks, detention and retention basins, culverts, erosion and sediment control systems, aircraft arresting system foundations and containment vaults, blast deflectors, airfield perimeter security fencing, and related site-civil infrastructure. Subsurface utility corridors and distribution, including but not limited to utility distribution pathways, aircraft grounding grids, communication ductways, fuel servicing distribution pathways supporting horizontal operations, and associated utility routing. title: Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC)
description: The Naval Surface Warfare Center, Philadelphia Division is providing a Request for Proposal (RFP) for an IDIQ MACC to provide all management, labor, material, equipment, transportation, supervision, environmental, quality, and security controls to accomplish simultaneous sustainment, repair, maintenance (SRM) and minor construction projects at its Philadelphia Navy Yard Annex (PNYA) and Naval Support Activity Philadelphia (NSA-P) locations.In general, construction projects performed under this MACC will require the ability to manage multiple task orders concurrently at both NSWCPD locations. This MACC will encompass a range of Design-Build (DB) and Design-Bid-Build (DBB) projects that include, but are not limited to, new minor construction; demolition, repair, alteration, and renovation of existing buildings, systems and infrastructure; and, may include civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, fire protection, and communication systems. Types of facilities include administrative, industrial, maintenance, warehouses, light laboratories, full-scale test sites, communications, personnel support, recreation, parking lots, roads, etc. in support of NSWCPD. More specifically, projects carried out under the NSWCPD MACC may include, but are not limited to, the following facility types, equipment, and systems:a) Roofingb) Interior/Exterior Renovationsc) Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC)d) Paintinge) Pavingf) Low Impact Development (LID)g) Environmental/Hazardous Material Abatementh) Concrete/Foundation Worki) Electrical Systems Maintenance / Renovationsj) Fire Protection and Life Safetyk) Telecommunication l) Plumbingm) Facility and Personnel Security Systemsn) Furniture, Fixtures, and Equipment o) Elevatorsp) Cooling towersWork performed under this contract will be complex in nature and require multiple technical and professional disciplines working simultaneously to include coordination with Architect-Engineer (A-E) Contractors as necessary. All such work shall be accomplished in strict accordance with applicable or relevant and appropriate Navy and local instructions, processes, and procedures and applicable building and life safety code requirements.The contract performance period will span five years from the date of award. Each Task Order will identify specific completion date. The cumulative total of all task orders issued under the IDIQ MACC among all MACC holders will not exceed the total, maximum contract ceiling amount of $74,222,627. Projects for the MACC have an estimated total cost between $250,000 and $2,500,000; however, smaller and larger dollar-value projects may be considered by the Government.The solicitation will be 100% Small Business set-aside. title: RFP to Lease the Dun Glen Ark in New River Gorge National Park and Preserve
description: SUMMARY OF LEASING OPPORTUNITY This Request for Proposals (RFP) provides the opportunity for any interested individual or organization, hereinafter referred to as �Offeror� to submit proposals to the National Park Service (�NPS�, �Lessor�) to lease NPS property at New River Gorge National Park and Preserve (�New River Gorge�, �NERI�, �the Park�) for a Commercial Use under the following general terms and conditions. The selected Offeror (�offeror�, �you�, �your�) will have exclusive negotiation rights to enter into a lease based on the attached Sample Lease (See Attachment A). Elements of your proposal may be incorporated into the Lease at Lessor�s discretion. OBJECTIVES New River Gorge has seen a 40% increase in visitation since 2020. In 2023, the Park saw 1.71 million visitors and expects growth to continue into the coming years. Visitors to the national park spent ~$80 million in local communities around the park in 2021 and 2022, representing just a fraction of the $9 billion consumer spending on West Virginia outdoor recreation annually according to Outdoor Industry Association�s recreation economy report in 2022. New River Gorge has an extensive inventory of historic buildings throughout the park requiring rehabilitation and day-to-day maintenance. The Park is looking to revitalize these properties by seeking out qualified individuals to establish commercial businesses that are aligned to the Park�s mission and willing to take on all associated rehabilitation and maintenance costs. New River Gorge�s objective is to lease historic buildings to Lessees who demonstrate they can undertake rehabilitation of the structures in accordance with the Secretary of Interior�s Standards for the treatment of Historic Properties and demonstrate the financial capability to carry out the rehabilitation they propose to undertake. OVERVIEW OF THE PROPERTY OFFERED FOR LEASE The Dun Glen Ark, commonly known as the Ark, is located at 136 Dun Glen Parking Lot (McKendree Road), Thurmond, West Virginia, 25936 (37.95326077191746, -81.0755964412642). The lease premises solely includes the structural footprint of the Ark, Mini Ark, and Boat Storage Rack, while all surrounding property will be maintained by the Park for public use. The Ark is a two-story, approximately 3,276 sq. ft. structure with natural-stained wood siding and a second-floor balcony wrapping around the front (eastern, river-facing) side. A large garage door at the front allows for movement of watercraft and other large objects from the spacious single-bay ground floor directly onto the gravel Dun Glen river access road, about 50 feet from the boat ramp. The Mini Ark is a one-story approximately 984 sq. ft. structure built in a similar style to the Ark. The Mini Ark has three rooms, with inoperable restrooms in the back of the outside two. Room one is approximately 13� by 15�. Rooms two and three are approximately 12� by 20�. The Boat Storage Rack is an open air approximately 224 sq. ft. structure. The underside of the roof is 7-8 feet off the ground and 28� long by 9� wide. There are three support posts with three storage racks on each post. The lease premises include 0.41 acres of land as shown in Exhibit 1 below. The lease does not include reserved parking in the public parking lot, but parking could be added in the lease area next to the Mini Ark. The Ark was built in 1975 as part of the Wildwater Unlimited rafting company�s Dun Glen base of operations and originally used to house equipment in large bays on the ground floor and administrative offices above. From the turn of the 20th century through the next three decades, it was the site of the Dun Glen Hotel, which served the residents of the area as well as rail travelers passing through the town of Thurmond on the opposite bank of the river. Long after the hotel was destroyed by arson in 1930, the property passed into the ownership of Wildwater Unlimited, the first commercial rafting outfitter in West Virginia. The rafting company enjoyed many years of success before being acquired by a competitor, after which Dun Glen was sold to the NPS and transformed into a public day use area. Due to Dun Glen�s close affiliation with the establishment of the whitewater rafting industry in the state, the structures and the area are considered eligible for the National Register of Historic Places and must be treated similarly to other listed historic properties. The Mini Ark and Boat Storage Rack were added in 1985. The Ark lies fully within the Dun Glen Day Use Area, immediately adjacent to the main public boat launch into the New River. The Park�s priorities in Dun Glen are to maintain public access to the river and offer visitors a place to gather in close proximity to the area�s trails and the Thurmond Historic District. Dun Glen also serves as the gateway to Thurmond in the sense that it has better and more robust river access, parking capacity, event space, and utilities than available on the other side of the river. To reach Dun Glen, take U.S. Route 19 to the Glen Jean exit, north of Beckley. Follow the signs to Thurmond, seven miles down WV Route 25 (Route 25 is a narrow, winding road and is not recommended for RVs and trailers). Turn right onto the McKendree Road intersection immediately before crossing the Thurmond railroad bridge. Continue approximately 0.1 miles and the entrance to Dun Glen will be on the left along the river off McKendree Road. Park at the Upper Dun Glen Lot or continue along the river access road to the lower level to reach the Ark. From Dun Glen, Thurmond is 0.4 miles north across the railroad and auto bridge over the New River, the Stone Cliff Campground is 1.5 miles south down McKendree Road, the New River Gorge administrative headquarters is 6.4 miles west in the town of Glen Jean. The cities of Fayetteville and Beckley, WV are each located approximately 16 miles north and 19 miles south, respectively, along US Route 19. Allowed Uses of the Lease Premises The Ark is available for commercial use, this may include but is not limited to office space, tour operations, retail sale of consumer-packaged goods or other merchandise, rental of outdoor or other recreation equipment, or as an event venue (subject to NPS approval). The lessee may not use the premises for the following purposes: private use restricting access to the general public such as members-only clubs, illegal activities including but not limited to gambling, marijuana, or firearms, overnight lodging. Key Information About This Leasing Opportunity Deferred Maintenance: The roof of the Dun Glen Ark needs to be replaced, offerors willing to undertake this project should specify this in their proposal. A rental payment offset will be made available if a Lessee completes the work. Mail to: NERI_leasing@nps.gov. Building Codes and Zoning: The NPS will expect any work done on the property, where relevant, to meet the standards set forth by the 2024 ICC family of Codes and all codes referenced in those codes. For fire codes, follow all codes referenced in NPS Director�s Order #58 and NPS Reference Manual #58. For accessibility, work must meet the ICC Codes and the Architectural Barriers Act Accessibility Standard (ABAAS). Additionally, Certificates of Occupancy are issued by the NPS Building Code Official. Historic Preservation: Construction design, authorization, regulatory compliance, and permitting will be required to comply with one or several of the following: the Secretary of the Interior's Standards and Guidelines; National Historic Preservation Act (NHPA) and Section 106 compliance; National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA); NFPA 914 Code for Protection of Historical Structures. Please note that your proposal may trigger compliance processes in accordance with one or more of the laws, regulations or policies listed above. The cost of any such compliance process as well as the costs of plan check, code review and construction inspections will be borne by the Lessee. Pu

title: RESERVE BASIN MAINTENANCE DREDGING CONTRACT FOR SITES AT THE PHILDELPHIA NAVY YARD IN THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT PENNSYLVANIA AREA OF RESPONSIBILIY
description: The project consists of Maintenance Dredging within the North Side (Wharf N) of Reserve Basin and Schuylkill River Access Channel for the Government sites at the Philadelphia Navy Yard in the Public Works Department Pennsylvania area of responsibility. Maintenance dredging of approximately 96,611 cubic yards of sediment, using a sealed environmental clamshell bucket. Dredging within the Reserve Basin is in support of the Naval Support Activity Mechanicsburg, Philadelphia Navy Yard Annex. The Reserve Basin is being used to decommission various US Naval vessels. For the river pilots to be able to safely maneuver vessels through the Schuylkill River into the Reserve Basin berths and to ensure that tidal cycles will not cause sediment accumulation around the hulls making final removal very difficult, the berths need to be dredged to a minimum depth of -30 MLLW and a maximum over-dredge depth of -32 MLLW.

description: Request for Proposal (RFP) - 15BRRC26R00000023 Residential Reentry Center Services to be Located within the city limits of Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. Home Confinement Radius 120 miles within RRC Facility The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes which to be located within the city limits of Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. Home Confinement Radius 120 miles of RRC Facility. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work (SOW) entitled, �Residential Reentry Center, March, 2022�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, programs, of the aforementioned SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be a Firm-Fixed Price/IDIQ contract for services with a one-year base period, and four, one-year option period. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 15 beds (15 males and 0 females) for the base year and an estimated maximum 30 beds (26 males and 4 females) for facility. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 13 placements (for the base year) and an estimated maximum 25 placements. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. 15BRRC26R00000023 will be available on or about November 16, 2026, and it will be distributed solely through the General Services Administration's Federal Business Opportunities website at https://SAM.gov. title: Procurement of an Automation Platform for Enzyme Engineering (APEE)
description:
The automation platform for enzyme engineering must be provided with all hardware, software, and system controls required for high-throughput screening of enzyme libraries. The offering must include a fully integrated, turnkey solution. Furthermore, the platform must enable an automated workflow capable of identifying enzyme variants that efficiently catalyze selected chemical transformations. The system must be capable of performing the steps described in the documentation fully automatically.




As part of this workflow, it must be possible to process at least 24 microtiter plates (96-well) per week (see the “Workflow” document). The products listed in the request for proposals are examples intended to illustrate the required performance level. Equivalent products are permitted; the supplier must demonstrate equivalence.




Since the APEE will be operated by both experienced and less experienced users, high operational efficiency, high operational stability, and high user-friendliness of both hardware and software are of central importance. In addition, the system’s dimensions must fit within the laboratory space available for this purpose. The available room dimensions are specified in the eligibility criteria.

title: Germany – Office block construction work – Vergabeverfahren zum Erwerb einer Neuen Zentrale der Deutschen Bundesbank
description: Die Deutsche Bundesbank (nachfolgend auch "Bundesbank" oder "Auftraggeberin" genannt) ist die Zentralbank der Bundesrepublik Deutschland. Sie hat Verfassungsrang als bundesunmittelbare juristische Person des öffentlichen Rechts und ist integraler Bestandteil des Europäischen Systems der Zentralbanken. Sie wirkt mit dem vorrangigen Ziel, die Preisstabilität zu gewährleisten, verwaltet die Währungsreserven, sorgt für die bankmäßige Abwicklung des Zahlungsverkehrs im Inland und Ausland und trägt zur Stabilität der Zahlungs- und Verrechnungssysteme bei. Ihre Zentrale befindet sich in Frankfurt am Main und steht für die Erfüllung dieser gesetzlichen Kernaufgaben sowie die öffentliche Wahrnehmung der Institution. Mit dem Ende der Nutzungsdauer der bisherigen Zentrale und einer interimistischen Unterbringung in angemieteten Flächen ergibt sich für die Bundesbank die Notwendigkeit, eine moderne, repräsentative und zukunftsfähige Liegenschaft für die künftige Zentrale der Bundesbank zu erwerben. Der Erwerb der Liegenschaft auf der Grundlage eines noch zu verhandelnden Grundstückskaufvertrages mit Bauverpflichtung (Bauträgervertrag mit endfälliger Zahlung zum Festpreis) (auch "Kaufvertrag" genannt) ist Gegenstand dieses Vergabeverfahrens. Der Grundstückskaufvertrag bedarf der notariellen Beurkundung. Es ist derzeit vorgesehen, dass die Zuschlagserteilung und die notarielle Beurkundung in unmittelbarem zeitlichen Zusammenhang erfolgen. Der Entwurf des Grundstückskaufvertrages wird den im Teilnahmewettbewerb ausgewählten Bietern von der Bundesbank als Verhandlungsgrundlage zur Verfügung gestellt. Ziel der Beschaffung ist die Bündelung der Arbeitsplätze der Zentrale in einer Liegenschaft und die Abbildung der in den Vergabeunterlagen beschriebenen Anforderungen und Funktionen in einem Ensemble, das architektonisch und funktional den besonderen Anforderungen der Bundesbank entspricht. Nach derzeitigem Stand sind die Anforderungen der Bundesbank in einem zusammenhängenden Gebäudeensemble umzusetzen. Eine Änderung dieser Anforderungen ist im Rahmen des Verhandlungsverfahrens möglich. In der Liegenschaft sind Flächen für verschiedene Sonderfunktionen zu integrieren. Hierzu zählen nach aktuellem Stand beispielsweise ein differenziertes Konferenz- und Besprechungsangebot, eine umfassende Betriebsgastronomie (einschließlich Vorstandsgastronomie), Flächen für Fahrbereitschaft und Logistik sowie Sicherheitszentralen. Es ist nicht ausgeschlossen, dass Sonderfunktionen im Rahmen des Verhandlungsverfahrens entfallen, geändert werden oder andere Sonderfunktionen hinzukommen. Zur Umsetzung der Anforderungen kommt sowohl ein Neubau als auch eine Kernsanierung eines bestehenden Gebäudes oder eine Kombination hieraus in Betracht. Die Abnahme und Übergabe der vertragsgemäß hergestellten Liegenschaft durch die Bundesbank muss nach aktueller Planung spätestens sieben Jahre nach Zuschlagserteilung erfolgen (Meilenstein). Die zeitlichen Vorgaben und die Meilensteine können sich im Laufe des Vergabeverfahrens ändern. Eine verbindliche Festlegung der zeitlichen Vorgaben ist im Laufe des Verhandlungsverfahrens für alle Meilensteine vorgesehen. Nach § 2 S. 2 des Gesetzes über die Deutsche Bundesbank hat die Bundesbank ihren Sitz in Frankfurt am Main. Das Auswahlgebiet, in welchem die verfahrensgegenständliche Liegenschaft liegen muss, ist das Stadtgebiet Frankfurt am Main mit der sicherheitsbedingten Ausnahme der Bereiche des Flughafenareals und der nahegelegenen Gateway Gardens (Gemarkung 0518). Das Auswahlgebiet ergibt sich aus der Unterlage Auswahlgebiet (Anlage 1) und ist bei der Wahl des Standortes zwingend einzuhalten. Bei Widersprüchen hinsichtlich des Auswahlgebietes zwischen der Beschreibung in den übrigen Vergabeunterlagen und Anlage 1 gilt Anlage 1 vorrangig. Werden Grundstücke und/oder Liegenschaften angeboten, die sich ganz oder teilweise außerhalb des Auswahlgebietes befinden, führt dies zum zwingenden Ausschluss des Teilnahmeantrages. Die Liegenschaft muss auf einem Grundstück im Auswahlgebiet hergestellt werden, über welches der Auftragnehmer nach Maßgabe der Vergabeunterlagen im Zuschlagsfall zur Erbringung der ausgeschriebenen Leistung rechtssicher verfügen und der Bundesbank Eigentum an dem zu bebauenden Grundstück frei von nicht übernommenen Belastungen nach Maßgabe der Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere des Grundstückskaufvertrages und seiner Anlagen verschaffen kann. Der Grundstückskaufvertrag und die Anforderungen an das Grundstück sind Gegenstand der Vertragsverhandlungen in der Verhandlungsphase und können sich noch ändern. Von den Bewerbern bzw. den Bietern sind nach Maßgabe der Vergabeunterlagen Erklärungen zum Grundstück abzugeben, aus denen sich je nach Verfahrensstufe immer konkreter ergibt, ob das angebotene Grundstück die Anforderungen der Bundesbank erfüllt. Welche Unterlagen diesbezüglich mit dem Teilnahmeantrag einzureichen sind, ergibt sich aus der Checkliste der vom Bewerber einzureichenden Unterlagen, die mit den Vergabeunterlagen zur Verfügung gestellt wird. Die Liegenschaft mit der noch zu errichtenden oder umzubauenden Immobilie muss die Anforderungen der Bundesbank erfüllen, die in den Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere der Funktionalen Leistungsbeschreibung, im Raum- und Funktionsprogramm sowie den jeweils näher definierten Ausstattungs- und Nutzungsvorgaben aufgeführt sind. Diese Unterlagen sind Gegenstand der Vergabeunterlagen, die ausschließlich den Bietern, die zur Abgabe eines Angebotes aufgefordert werden, zur Verfügung gestellt werden. Eine Änderung oder Konkretisierung der Anforderungen im Rahmen des Verhandlungsverfahrens ist möglich. Damit die Bewerber bewerten können, ob sie die Anforderungen - ggf. mit Konsortialpartnern und/oder Nachunternehmern und/oder Eignungsgebern erfüllen können, ist den Vergabeunterlagen zum Teilnahmewettbewerb eine Informative Leistungsbeschreibung beigefügt. Hierin sind ausgewählte wesentliche Anforderungen der Auftraggeberin aufgeführt.

Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä: Lääkevalmisteet ja niihin rinnastettavat tuotteet
description: Tällä ilmoituksella perustetaan dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä (Dynamic Purchasing System; DPS). Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän (DPS) kohteena ovat HUSin ja muiden mukana olevien hankintayksiköiden tarvitsemat Lääkevalmisteet ja niihin rinnastettavat tuotteet. Hankittavat lääkevalmisteet ja niihin rinnastettavat tuotteet määritellään tarkemmin kussakin dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisessä kilpailutuksessa. Pyydämme osallistumishakemuksia lääkevalmisteiden ja niihin rinnastettavien tuotteiden dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään otetaan mukaan kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät ehdokkaat. Varsinaiset hankinnat tehdään dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla. 30.1.2023 TEHTY SEURAAVAT MUUTOKSET: Tarjoajan osallistumisvaatimuksista on poistettu vaatimus toiminnan vastuuvakuutuksesta. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän päivämääriä on muutettu. Pyydämme osallistumishakemuksia lääkevalmisteiden ja niihin rinnastettavien tuotteiden dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään (DPS). Hankinnan kohteena dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisällä ovat lääkevalmisteet ja niihin rinnastettavat tuotteet. Tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ulkopuolelle jäävät sellaiset HUS Apteekin kilpailutukset, joissa hankintarengas on laajempi ja muodostetaan useampien hankintayksiköiden (esim. kaikki Suomen hyvinvointialueet) kesken (esimerkkeinä HIV-lääkkeiden kilpailutus, Hepatiitti-C:n hoitoon tarkoitettujen interferonivapaiden valmisteiden kilpailutus). Tämän dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ulkopuolelle jäävät myös Radiofarmaseuttisten valmisteiden sekä Lääkkeellisten, teollisten ja muiden sairaalakaasujen kilpailutukset. DYNAAMISEN HANKINTAJÄRJESTELMÄN OSALLISTUMISHAKEMUKSET Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän osallistumishakemukset lähetetään Cloudian Tarjouspalvelussa (https://www.tarjouspalvelu.fi). Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voi hakea ehdokkaaksi, jos täyttää soveltuvuusvaatimukset, jotka on ilmoitettu ESPD-lomakkeessa sekä kohdassa "Muut ehdot". Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään otetaan mukaan kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät ehdokkaat. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään voi jättää osallistumishakemuksia koko sen keston ajan. Osallistumishakemusten jättämiselle on DPS:n perustamisvaiheessa varattu aikaa 30 vuorokautta (24.2.2023 saakka) siten, että siihen mennessä toimitetut hyväksytyt osallistumishakemukset ehtivät ensimmäiseen sisäiseen kilpailutukseen, jonka tarjouspyyntöä ei julkaista ennen 3.3.2023. Vain ehdokkaat, jotka on hyväksytty Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään, voivat jättää tarjouksia DPS:n sisäisiin kilpailutuksiin. Dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksytyt ehdokkaat voivat osallistua yhteen tai useampaan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäiseen kilpailutukseen. DYNAAMISEN HANKINTAJÄRJESTELMÄN KESTO Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän kesto on 16.1.2023-16.1.2027 (48 kuukautta) Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän hankintavaihe alkaa perustamisvaiheen jälkeen, aikaisintaan 3.3.2023. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän hankintavaihe päättyy dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän voimassaoloajan päättyessä 16.1.2027. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä voidaan tilapäisesti sulkea esim. kesälomakauden ajaksi. DPS:n sulkemisesta ilmoitetaan tarvittaessa tarjoajille erikseen. Osallistumishakemuksia ei käsitellä dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän ollessa suljettuna. DYNAAMISEN HANKINTAJÄRJESTELMÄN SISÄISET KILPAILUTUKSET Varsinaiset hankinnat tehdään dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla, joissa kuvataan ja täsmennetään hankinnan kohde. HUS voi alkaa julkaista sisäisten kilpailutusten tarjouspyyntöjä hankintavaiheen alettua 3.3.2023. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisten kilpailutusten tarjouspyynnöissä kuvataan kuhunkin sisäiseen kilpailutukseen kuuluvat lääkevalmisteet ja niihin rinnastettavat tuotteet sekä niiden tarkemmat vertailu- ja valintaperusteet. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisäisten kilpailutusten tarjouspyynnöt julkaistaan KILPO kilpailutusportaalissa (https://www.kilpo.fi). Tarjoukset jätetään KILPO kilpailutusportaaliin. Tieto uuden sisäisen kilpailutuksen käynnistymisestä välitetään kaikille dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään hyväksytyille ehdokkaille Cloudian Tarjouspalvelun (https://www.tarjouspalvelu.fi) kautta.
